meta.title: Tongji AIGC image / video generation
meta.description: Reverse-proxy the Tongji AIGC workspace (agi.tongji.edu.cn) into DSH: text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video and image-to-video. Log in via a browser redirect, then use the full set of host-side tools; outputs are written to disk and returned as absolute paths.
